summary: Shape terminal interfaces around what users need to understand and do, including states, recovery, and keyboard behavior.

scenarios.title: Design an interactive CLI flow
scenarios.prompt: Use $design-terminal-ux to design this deployment wizard for occasional users who need safe defaults and clear recovery.
scenarios.outcome: A right-sized flow covering hierarchy, input, progress, errors, completion, cancellation, and keyboard access.

scenarios.title: Audit a dense TUI
scenarios.prompt: Use $design-terminal-ux to audit this TUI screenshot and remove elements that do not support a real user decision.
scenarios.outcome: A prioritized critique grounded in user tasks, terminal constraints, meaningful states, and accessibility.
